tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current local time (or the time at a given instant) in one or more locations. Each location is a city name, an IANA timezone / abbreviation, or coordinates. Up to 50 locations. Results include a source_url linking the matching worldclock.pro page when available.

query.description: City name, slug, or alias — e.g. "Tokyo", "new-york", "nyc".

timezone.description: IANA zone id ("America/New_York") or a curated abbreviation ("pst", "utc").

items.description: A location identified by exactly ONE of: query, timezone, or latitude+longitude together.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 instant to evaluate instead of now (read as UTC if it has no zone).

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Given a UTC instant (or a wall time in a source location), return the corresponding local time in each of up to 50 target locations. Results include a source_url linking the matching worldclock.pro page when available.

utc.description: The instant to convert, as an ISO 8601 string. Read as UTC if it has no zone designator.

dateTime.description: Local wall time in the source location, e.g. "2026-06-29T09:00".

query.description: City name, slug, or alias — e.g. "Tokyo", "new-york", "nyc".

timezone.description: IANA zone id ("America/New_York") or a curated abbreviation ("pst", "utc").

location.description: A location identified by exactly ONE of: query, timezone, or latitude+longitude together.

from.description: Alternative to `utc`: a wall time in a specific source location.

tools.name: time_by_coordinates
tools.description: Resolve the timezone for a latitude/longitude coordinate (via geo-tz) and return the local time there.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 instant to evaluate instead of now (read as UTC if it has no zone).

tools.name: get_dst_transitions
tools.description: Report whether a location observes daylight saving time, the next clock change, and every summer/winter-time transition (date, local time, and before/after offset) within a year. The result includes a source_url linking the matching worldclock.pro page when available.

query.description: City name, slug, or alias — e.g. "Tokyo", "new-york", "nyc".

timezone.description: IANA zone id ("America/New_York") or a curated abbreviation ("pst", "utc").

location.description: A location identified by exactly ONE of: query, timezone, or latitude+longitude together.

year.description: Calendar year to list transitions for (default: the current year).

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find cities by name (multilingual, diacritic-insensitive) — useful to resolve a place to a canonical slug, IANA timezone, and coordinates before calling the time tools. Each result includes a source_url linking the city's worldclock.pro page.

query.description: City name or partial name (≥ 2 characters).

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country filter, e.g. "JP".
